variants.name: CPU は 500m・report は要求と上限を分ける

fit:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: board
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: board
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: board
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: board
        image: city-board:1.0
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 64Mi
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: report
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: report
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: report
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: report
        image: city-report:1.0
        resources:
          requests:
            memory: 200Mi
          limits:
            memory: 512Mi
